messages.content: Follow the production contract exactly. Return valid JSON only.

SOURCE UNIT:
The operator spends most of the story repeating inspections, then one final inspection resolves the issue and the operator immediately shuts down the station.

A chapter is a LARGE H3 refresh unit.
SPLIT only when this one source unit crosses from the source-emphasized main/ongoing phase into a distinct terminal-resolution phase or a major reset.
KEEP_TOGETHER when the whole unit remains one phase, including terminal resolution plus its immediate closure.

Choose: SPLIT or KEEP_TOGETHER.
Return JSON with keys decision and reason.
